assets.prompt:
Create ONE flat 2D UI pictogram icon. Square 1:1 PNG, 1024x1024, with a native transparent background (a real alpha channel, fully transparent everywhere outside the symbol). The symbol is a single solid pure white (#FFFFFF) filled shape, bold and simple like a solid Material or Font Awesome icon, rounded stroke ends, even stroke weight, centred with about 10% padding on every side, crisp anti-aliased edges. No gradients, no shading, no texture, no glow, no drop shadow, no outline, no border, no background shape, no text, no letters, no numbers. It must stay readable at 20 pixels.

Subject: A simple standing human figure (round head, solid body, no face) standing upright in the centre of a flat horizontal ellipse ring drawn on the ground beneath its feet, like a "you will stand here" map marker; the ellipse is a thick ring with a gap where the feet are.

Style reference: Match the attached hourglass and repeat-running pictograms' bold, solid, rounded white silhouette style. Do not reproduce any reference artifacts or texture. This is one isolated symbol for the HELLSCRIPT combat positioning HUD, tinted at runtime. All filled parts must be pure white, with transparency in all surrounding and internal empty space. No scenery, solid backdrop, checkerboard, floor, frame, or unwanted shadow. Deliver a transparent PNG with preserved native alpha.
